title: 75 production functions are referenced only by tests
note: Spot-checked 13 named symbols (jobWatchTool, noteDelegateAttention, nextIdleDelegateAttention, completionSnapshot, watchCount, sendInput, reconcileDelegateThreadItems, cloneNavigationSnapshot, localEnvPolicyFromName, writeAPIWireError, grepOutput, abandonRunningJob, createJobOutputForID): each has exactly 1 non-test word-match (the declaration) and 3-85 test refs. jobWatchTool is a one-line context.Background() wrapper (agent/session_tools_jobs.go:141); sendInput begins `_ = ctx` (agent/subagents.go:1440). Total 75 not re-derived.

title: jobManager.createShell is a test-only second shell-job start
note: Confirmed: agent/jobs.go:991 createShell has zero non-test callers, 197 test call sites (not 238; the 238 likely counts the createShellOpts literals too) and builds record + EventJobStarted + registers runningJob, parallel to the commit path in agent/job_shell.go ~616-690. But it is a test fixture helper that creates a job with no process, not a competing production path, so it does not cause drift in prod; high is overstated.
revised_fix_plan: Move createShell and createShellOpts verbatim into an agent/*_test.go helper file (about 85+10 lines moved, zero call-site churn). Do NOT convert 197 tests to spawn real shell commands: that adds processes and timing nondeterminism, contrary to deterministic-tests rules. Optionally extract the shared EventJobStarted construction (duplicated at jobs.go:1033-1049 and job_shell.go:~614-634) into one builder used by both, which is the only real drift risk.

title: Path-based job-output snapshot readers are a test-only twin of fd-based readers
note: Confirmed: ReadOutputSnapshot/ReadOutputWindowSnapshot/ReadOutputPageSnapshot (agent/internal/jobstore/output_snapshot.go:63,91,109) have no non-test caller. But the 'delete the chain' scope is overstated: observeOutputSnapshot is NOT path-only (output_snapshot_fd.go:242 calls it) and readOutputMetaForSnapshot, outputSnapshotWindow, trimOutputSnapshotWindow are shared (fd.go:140,246,251). Realistic deletion is ~250 lines (readOutputSnapshotOnce/Attempt, readOutputRangeSnapshotOnce/Attempt, readOutputRawSnapshotWindow, readOutputSnapshotWindow, WithRetry wrappers, three public entry points). Real stale doc: agent/retained_output_read.go:88-90 searchSource comment names jobstore.ReadOutputWindowSnapshot.
revised_fix_plan: Delete only the functions with no caller from output_snapshot_fd.go after grep-checking each; keep observeOutputSnapshot and the shared window helpers. Port unique race/rotation cases from output_snapshot_test.go to the fd tests first. Fix the retained_output_read.go comment. Size about -250 prod.

title: llm StreamGenerate/StreamGenerateObject have no production caller
note: Non-test grep: StreamGenerate referenced only at its definition (llm/stream_generate.go:135) and the seam var llm/generate_object.go:23; StreamGenerateObject only at :117. stream_generate.go 425 lines, generate_object.go 300 (total 725). Caveat: docs/subagent-management/08-standalone-llm-calls.md:15,18,38 states llm.StreamGenerate/StreamGenerateObject as intended reuse paths, so this is a product/SDK decision (llm is its own go module), as the finding says. Also stream_retry.go is shared with other paths (FuzzRetryStream exists), so only the StreamGenerate half can go.
revised_fix_plan: Ask Jesse whether llm is a public SDK. If not, delete stream_generate.go and the streaming half of generate_object.go plus seam var, tests, any fuzz target tied only to them, and update the 08-standalone-llm-calls.md doc rows; keep stream_retry.go pieces still used elsewhere.

title: Root frontmatter package duplicates agent/internal/frontmatter

Package is 364 lines incl. tests; its doc comment says it matches agent/internal/frontmatter which this module cannot import (agent is a separate go.mod). title: Unused hub REST proxy and tree-builder wrappers
note: RESTProxy (cmd/evener-hub/internal/hubcore/proxy.go) has no non-test reference and no /live route outside proxy.go itself: confirmed. Correction: the production seam var is hubBuildNavigationTree = hubcore.BuildTreeWithProjects (web_api_tree.go:34), a thin wrapper that calls BuildTreeAtWithProjects, not BuildTreeAtWithProjects directly. BuildTree/BuildTreeAt/BuildProjectTree have no non-test caller (BuildTreeAt has 89 test refs); BuildProjectTreeAt is a distinct function with its own logic, so only the wrappers should go.
revised_fix_plan: Delete proxy.go and its tests. Move BuildTree, BuildTreeAt, BuildProjectTree into a hubcore _test.go helper (they are tiny time.Now/ResolveProjectMap adapters); do not touch BuildTreeWithProjects or BuildProjectTreeAt.
